notes.title: Update v1.3 is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25645647/77537f43c299b176d1b6b85f7407a99b6ef2492f.png[/img]

[h1]WHAT'S NEW[/h1]
[list]
    [*] [b]NEW MATH.[/b] Now you'll get to solve all-new Addition (+) and Subtraction (−) problems in addition to Multiplication (×) ones.
    [*] More stability fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.2 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]WHAT'S NEW[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]BALANCING[/b] A lot of fixes were made to map generation system, which should allow more enjoyable playthroughs with much less randomness involved. Now it's up to you to do your best and leave the planet!
    [*][b]BUFGIXES[/b] Several minor UI bugs with invisible buttons were fixed.
    [*][b]BETTER GLOBAL MAP[/b] Now you'll see when you found everything useful int the sector.
[/list]
Some of you had troubles with finding enough silicon and aluminum in the 3rd ring, which is much needed for top level upgrades and completing the game. I spent the weekend adjusting the game's balance, so here is a final result of my take on the endgame.

And thank you everyone who reported the problems and escaped out of the planet!

If you have enjoyed the new update and the game, I encourage you to leave a review on Steam so more people could enjoy it as well! Thanks!

Have a productive week everyone!

notes.title: Update v1.1 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Advanced Global Map[/b]: Now you can see which sectors you have already visited and which ones you cleared completely.
    [*][b]Balancing[/b]: Improved map generation and better overall materials balancing.
[/list]

[h1]BUGFIXES[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Nasty bug which allowed to quickly finish the game is fixed now.
    [*]Engine upgrade is now affecting the search time more effecienty.
    [*]Armor requirements were decreased.
    [*]Antenna: fixed missing image for the quest item and Russian translation for it.
    [*]Quests: "Upgrade the robot" quest was fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Happy Brazing!
notes.content:
Hello, all!

Long wait is over, and Brazed is finally out now.

I've spent a lot of time working on it, but right now all I want is you to have fun with it.

Happy upcoming holidays, and thank you for playing!

Rock on! ːpystarː
